title: Product filters & paging
tagline: The max price wipes out the min price, the total counts only one page, brand needs exact capitals, and page 0 shows the last page.
lookFor: Setting `filter.price = ...` twice replaces the first one. Combine them.
Count the total BEFORE cutting it into pages.
Exact match that ignores capitals: anchored pattern with the `i` flag.
`slice(-3)` counts from the END. Check page ≥ 1 first.

bugs.symptom: minPrice ignored when maxPrice is also given
bugs.cause: The second line replaces the first, so the minimum is lost.
bugs.fix: Build both into one object: `{ $gte: min, $lte: max }`.

bugs.cause: It counts the page, not all matches.

bugs.fix: Use an anchored pattern with `$options: 'i'`. See the reference fix.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: page=0 returns the last items
hints: skip = (0 − 1) × 3 = ? What does slice do with a negative start?
bugs.cause: A negative start counts from the end.
